title: A Brief History of the BSD Fast Filesystem by Marshall Kirk McKusick
summary: Marshall Kirk McKusick gives a talk at EuroBSDCon tracing filesystem and storage development from 1979 to today, using the BSD Fast Filesystem as the focus. It covers early disk-geometry optimization through later contiguous layout and small-file performance work.
why: Pointed to as the authoritative history of FFS from one of its original creators.

quote.text: For more history, perhaps see "A Brief History of the BSD Fast Filesystem by Marshall Kirk McKusick"
